title: Outplaying elite table tennis players with an autonomous robot
imageAlt: Nature cover, 23 April 2026: Match Point, featuring the ACE table tennis robot competing against a human player.
description: Project ACE brings learning, sensing, and control together at human speed: an autonomous robot taking on elite table tennis players.

title: OrthoNet: Multilayer Network Data Clustering
venue: IEEE Transactions on Signal and Information Processing over Networks
description: OrthoNet is a neural network that learns a graph embedding using an unsupervised objective inspired by spectral clustering. By shaping the embedding around the graph’s cluster structure, it produces vertex representations that can be directly partitioned with K-means.

title: GOT: An Optimal Transport framework for Graph comparison
venue: 33rd Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), Canada
description: GOT is a framework that leverages optimal transport theory to compare graphs. It provides a principled way to measure the similarity between graphs by considering the cost of transforming one graph into another.
